messages:
maria (ml): Kicking off sequential onboard for rwd-llm-v2q4 (int4/quantized). Quick sanity sweep before broad promote. Rollout: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50%, hold windows 30m/30m/60m/120m. Gate summary inlined below. @evan @sam pls watch infra and batching behavior.

sam (platform): +1. Agree. Add minimum sample size per step: 1k requests or 10k tokens, whichever comes first. Also recommend p95 latency delta cap at +80ms for first two steps, +120ms for 10% step.

maria (ml): noted. Primary quality gates: conv_f1_delta >= -0.5% (vs baseline v2fp16), hallucination_rate <= 1.0%, topk_token_shift <= 0.8 (slice-level). If any gate trips, auto-fallback to v2fp16 for that slice.

liz (product): Can we add a UX-heavy slice hold? If the longform scenario slice shows MRR drop >0.3% we stop. Longform is ~12% of traffic.

maria (ml): yes — longform slice explicit hold with stricter delta: conv_f1_delta >= -0.2% and latency_p95 cap +60ms.

evan (sre): infra checklist: GPU mem pressure reported for int4 is ok on 95th perc, but KV cache miss rate spiked on sample shadow run. I'll monitor batching tails. +watching the canary window.

deploy-bot: rollout.started model=rwd-llm-v2q4 target=0.005 id=prom-1715601234

sam (platform): quick note: enable prefix/KV cache warmup for the initial 0.5% run; without warmup we see noisy latency tail. Use `cache_warmup: true, warmup_window: 10m`.

maria (ml): on it. Also enabling shadow compare logs: will collect A/B deltas for primary slices (search, chat, longform, assist).

evan (sre): observed p95 +22ms at 0.5% after warmup, within gate. No errors.

maria (ml): sample A/B results after 30m 0.5%: conv_f1 delta +0.3%, hallucination_rate +0.02pp (within), longform MRR -0.05% (good), latency_p95 +28ms. Noise floor still visible on rare tokens.

liz (product): looks good so far. Proceed to 2% if infra stable.

deploy-bot: rollout.progress model=rwd-llm-v2q4 from=0.005 to=0.02 id=prom-1715601234

sam (platform): bumped to 2%. Reminder: hold 30m but watch for oscillation — if metric drift > 3 consecutive windows we abort.

maria (ml): 2% results @30m: conv_f1 delta +0.25%, hallucination +0.1pp, longform MRR -0.18% (still within -0.2% gate), latency_p95 +46ms. Small reg on a specific longtail slice (code-completion). Triggering targeted shadow run on that slice.

evan (sre): infra stable, no mem pressure, batching improved.

maria (ml): decision: allow 10% step but with targeted canary exclusions for code-completion slice until we have more signal. Documenting in rollout metadata.

deploy-bot: rollout.progress model=rwd-llm-v2q4 from=0.02 to=0.1 id=prom-1715601234

maria (ml): 10% @60m summary: conv_f1 delta -0.05% (within), hallucination +0.12pp (ok), longform MRR -0.25% (breach of -0.2% gate) -> PAUSE and auto-fallback for longform slice. Other slices healthy.

liz (product): thanks — longform fallback makes sense. What's plan to diagnose?

maria (ml): next steps: collect 10k longform samples, run targeted eval comparing beam/temperature differences and neutron test prompts. If model-level fixes slow, we keep general traffic but longform on v2fp16.

sam (platform): confirm auto-fallback enacted for longform slice (traffic routed to v2fp16). Also rolling back code-completion exclusion (still excluded).

deploy-bot: rollout.hold model=rwd-llm-v2q4 step=0.1 reason=longform_gate_breach action=fallback slice=longform id=prom-1715601234

evan (sre): infra note: fallbacks increased latency by ~12ms on the aggregated route due to routing overhead, still within global cap.

maria (ml): logging checklist: added detailed token-level diffs, perplexity slices, and hallucination classifier scores to the audit. Will re-run quantization knobs (nv4 tweak) on a 1k-sample dev set.

liz (product): please add a short postmortem note in the rollout metadata: cause=longform small-regression, mitigation=fallback+investigation, next_action=targeted eval.

maria (ml): added. If targeted eval shows fixable quantization artifact, we'll re-run a mini-candidate and requeue. Otherwise we cutoff promote at 10% and schedule a rollback.

sam (platform): agree. Also adding a conservative auto-rollback rule: if conv_f1_delta < -0.5% on aggregated primary slices for two consecutive hold windows -> full rollback to v2fp16.

maria (ml): ack. Thanks everyone. I'll post the eval outputs once the 10k longform batch completes. :thumbsup:

liz (product): thanks! Good controlled run. :eyes:

maria (ml): final note: keeping this thread for audit. File name for audit export: prom-1715601234-sequential-onboard-signal-sanity.json
